Given conflicting notes, the safe decision is to grant the lower level (read) since we can't verify the employee is actually a full-time engineer, and security indicates contractor with basic training. This aligns with least privilege.

Also, note that the Security agent's data is more specific to the access level evaluation (employment type + security training determine contractor max). The security database says contractor.

I'll go with read.

Let me submit decision: read, reason: conflicting info; Security database shows contractor with basic training, so maximum is read; requested write exceeds max, so grant read.
